mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS chunk_id,c.document_id,c.index_version_id,c.knowledge_base_id,c.content,c.chunk_order, c.source_start,c.source_end,c.heading_path,d.active_version_id,d.knowledge_base_id AS document_knowledge_base_id,v.document_id AS version_document_id FROM document_chunk c LEFT JOIN document d ON d.id=c.document_id LEFT JOIN document_index_version v ON v.id=c.index_version_id WHERE c.id IN #{id}
